title: comparisonPanes
responsibility: Pairs revision content with its own commit, label, role and explicit evidence gap.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.before
inputs.description: Parent revision content, source identity and gap; null means no parent evidence.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.after
inputs.description: Selected revision content, source identity and gap; never substituted from the parent.

inputs.name: comparisonPanes.paired
inputs.description: True by default for an ordered Before/After pair; false for one current snapshot.

outputs.name: comparisonPanes
outputs.description: Ordered parent and selected panes, or one current pane, each retaining its own value, commit, role, heading and gap.

errors.name: Side access error
errors.description: Errors from side property getters propagate; values are not cloned or serialized.
